fields.jar_callback: the jar's own alpha callback, never overridden (.claude/rules/datapacks.md); check reads it and fails unless it still names exactly the candy_tables, the type-table pattern and the type-tier threshold below
fields.candy_tables: the jar's alpha reward-tier loot tables, each overridden at its own path with an empty table ({"type": "minecraft:chest", "pools": []}); `items_as_read` is every item the jar's table carried, and check fails when the jar's table no longer carries exactly those
fields.type_tables: the jar's per-type loot tables our callback rolls: `pattern` with <type> a Pokemon type's showdown id and <tier> 1 or 2; `tier2_from_level` is the level from which the jar's callback (and ours) uses tier 2; `gem` is the item each type table must name
fields.jar_rolls: what the jar's callback rolls per KO besides its tier table: two independent 1-in-2 rolls of the type tables (primary, then the type it computes for slot 1)
fields.bands: our callback's extra rolls by the alpha's level at the faint: from `from_level` (inclusive) until the next band's; `extra_rolls` names which of the alpha's types each certain extra roll uses (`secondary` is the second type of a dual-type alpha and the only type of a single-type one; `primary` is the first type); `gems_per_ko` is the design's expected gems per KO, jar's rolls and ours together, which check recomputes from the jar's type tables and fails on a difference above 0.001

bands.why: leg 1 unchanged: the jar's two 1-in-2 rolls only (the design's 3.5 table, 'under 31')
one certain roll of the second type, so a dual-type alpha pays its second type whatever X5 finds about the jar's callback
the same roll, now at type tier 2 (2-3 gems a gem roll), as the jar's own rolls are
a second certain roll, of the first type: the alpha that used to pay tier-4 candies (about 57,000 EXP a KO) pays the most gems instead

not_covered: a dual-type alpha under level 31 gets only the jar's two rolls, which (if the X5 reading holds) are both its first type: the design keeps leg 1 at 1.125 gems a KO, and paying its second type there would change that figure. A caught alpha pays nothing: the event is battle_fainted only
